subject: Post-call recap & traffic handshake — InfiniHealth pilot
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Amalie Jensen <amalie.jensen@infinihealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-21T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & traffic handshake — InfiniHealth pilot

Amalie / InfiniHealth team — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have a single source of truth before the pilot kickoff: 

Summary of call:
- Pilot goal: validate InfiniHealth summarization flow (clinical notes -> de-identified summary) at production-like load and latency.
- Primary success criteria: 95th pctile generation latency < 550ms, end-to-end throughput meeting 3000 tokens/sec sustained during business hours, summary quality score >= 4.2 on your internal rubric.
- Constraint: PHI data will be pseudonymized before sending; we will run under your VPC for the private pilot.

Immediate asks for the team (what we need to create the PoC config and sizing):
1) Representative traffic sample (JSON) with: typical prompt length, typical and 95th token lengths, expected tokens per call, auth method for ingress, and any rate-limiting you already apply.
2) Concurrency pattern: expected concurrent users during peak minute and expected sustained concurrency.
3) Burst characteristics: typical burst size and frequency (e.g., spikes to 4x baseline for 5–10 minutes, daily at 09:00 ET).
4) Success metric owners: please confirm who on your side owns \"quality\" and who owns \"latency/ops\" so we can pull them into dashboarding.

Proposed timeline:
- By EOD Fri (07/23): InfiniHealth shares traffic_sample.json + confirmation of owners.
- Week of 07/26: Redwood prepares pilot config, sizing rec, and dedicated staging capacity.
- Week of 08/02: Canary run with 1% traffic; review results; adjust.
- Week of 08/09: Full pilot run (2 weeks) and joint evaluation.

Attachments: I attached a draft PoC matrix, and an example traffic_sample.json to help structure the data.

If the timeline above works, Marissa and Karthik will own the infra/config side from Redwood; Lauren will own billing/contract handoff. Amalie, can you confirm ownership and the date you expect to share the traffic sample?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.ai]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Amalie Jensen <amalie.jensen@infinihealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-22T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & traffic handshake — InfiniHealth pilot

Thanks Jordan — adding a few technical clarifications and a short checklist from infra/SE perspective.

High-level sizing inputs I need (please provide as fields in the JSON sample or a small CSV):
- target_rps: average and 95th percentile (requests per second).
- avg_prompt_tokens, avg_response_tokens, p95_prompt_tokens, p95_response_tokens (tokens).
- expected_concurrency_peak (parallel requests).
- burst_multiplier and burst_duration_avg (e.g., 3x for 8 minutes).
- streaming usage? (yes/no) and average streaming chunk size if yes.
- acceptable latency SLOs: p50/p95/p99 thresholds.

Quick checklist (Marissa / Karthik to own delivery):
[ ] Receive traffic sample + sample payloads (traffic_sample.json) — InfiniHealth
[ ] Confirm whether tokenization uses BPE vs byte-level (we can detect, but prefer confirmation) — InfiniHealth
[ ] Map endpoints: which flows hit generation vs reranking vs embeddings — InfiniHealth
[ ] Confirm data residency & VPC peering window (dates) — InfiniHealth ops
[ ] Redwood to draft per-variant VM/instance sizing + quantization recommendations — Redwood SEs

Success metrics (suggested):
- Functional: summary F1/ROUGE based on 100 eval prompts >= baseline 0.78; manual spot-check pass rate >= 90%
- Performance: p95 latency < 550ms; error rate < 0.5%
- Cost: per-1000-summaries token cost target <= $6 (for estimator)

I'll attach a lightweight PoC matrix (infini_poc_matrix.xlsx) with columns for flow, tokens, expected rps, owner, acceptance criteria. Sharing now.

-Marissa
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Amalie Jensen <amalie.jensen@infinihealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@infinihealth.com
Date: 2027-07-22T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & traffic handshake — InfiniHealth pilot

Appreciate the clear summary. Quick answers and attached sample.

Traffic snapshot (attached traffic_sample.json):
- avg_rps: 45 (during business hours), p95_rps: 180
- avg_prompt_tokens: 120, avg_response_tokens: 220
- p95_prompt_tokens: 600, p95_response_tokens: 900
- typical_concurrency_peak: 75 concurrent streams
- burst pattern: 4x baseline for 6–12 minutes, typically triggered at 08:30 ET and 12:30 ET; weekly batch runs on Sunday at 02:00 ET (batch size ~12k items)
- streaming: yes — mostly chunked summaries, average chunk 250 tokens

Owners:
- Quality owner: Dr. Ravi Patel (ravi.patel@infinihealth.com) — cc'd on ops alias.
- Ops/ingress owner: ops@infinihealth.com (cc'd).

Timeline: we can share the sanitized sample today (attached). Confirming target to start canary 08/02 — InfiniHealth agrees to the proposed schedule.

Constraints:
- We will only send pseudonymized records; anything that looks like live PHI must be marked and routed to the private pilot environment.
- We need an allowlist of Redwood IPs/egress and a short PO for staging capacity.

Files attached: traffic_sample.json, NDA_InfiniHealth_signed.pdf

Thanks,
Amalie Jensen
Product Lead, Data Platforms | InfiniHealth
amalie.jensen@infinihealth.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Amalie Jensen <amalie.jensen@infinihealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-23T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & traffic handshake — InfiniHealth pilot

Perfect — thanks Amalie and ops team. Quick confirmation of next steps and owners so we can checkpoint on Friday: 

Redwood owners and immediate actions:
- Marissa Cole: PoC matrix finalization, variant sizing, and canary config (ETA: 07/27). Attachment: infini_poc_matrix.xlsx (updated).
- Karthik Iyer: orchestration + KV cache policy, batching profile to support p95 tokens (ETA: 07/30).
- Lauren Bishop: draft staging PO and billing workflow; will send PO template and estimated monthly credit for staging (ETA: 07/24).

InfiniHealth owners and immediate actions:
- Amalie / ops@infinihealth.com: confirm IP allowlist window and share final sanitized traffic_sample.json (done) and verify VPC peering window (please confirm date).
- Ravi Patel: will be the primary quality contact for evaluation rubric and will own the manual review panel (please introduce by 07/26 if possible).

Canary plan (short):
1) Redwood deploys dedicated staging pool sized for p95 RPS + 30% buffer.
2) Run 1% traffic for 1 hour, capture traces, latency histograms, and token-level billing.
3) Joint review call within 24 hours of canary to assess regressions and quality.

Questions for InfiniHealth before we start:
- Do you want the canary to use streaming or non-streaming endpoints? (streaming will slightly change p95 behavior).
- Any IPs we should request immediately for allowlisting?

If no objections, we'll lock schedule and circulate invites for the canary review. Thanks everyone — Jordan will own the exec status to the AE and AM, and Lauren will own PO/billing as noted.

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai
